answers-name.description: Name used to store the combined submitted answer and grading result.

operator.description: Big operator to display and use when constructing the combined answer. When omitted, it must be inferable from a whole string or dictionary correct answer.

operator-latex.description: LaTeX used to display the operator. Supplying this without operator implies operator=custom; it is required for explicit custom operators and may override the display of built-in operators.

limits.description: Layout of the operator limits. Auto infers the layout from a parseable whole correct answer when available, otherwise selects the built-in operator's default layout; custom operators without a whole answer require an explicit bounds, domain, or approach form.

index-variable.description: Bound variable used by the operator and automatically allowed in the body expression. When omitted, it must be inferable from a whole string or dictionary correct answer.

variables.description: Comma-separated list of additional symbolic variables allowed in student input.

custom-functions.description: Comma-separated list of additional symbolic function names allowed in correct answers and student input.

limit-direction.description: Direction from which the index variable approaches the target for a limit operator.

allow-limit-direction-input.description: Whether students select the limit direction for approach limits. When false, the configured correct direction is displayed as fixed notation.

allowed-blank.description: Which portions of the response may be blank: none, limits, body, or all.

allow-complex.description: Whether complex numbers and the imaginary unit are allowed in symbolic component inputs.

show-help-text.description: Whether to show symbolic-entry help beside the body input.

body-size.description: Positive character width of the body symbolic input.

limit-size.description: Positive character width applied to every limit symbolic input. Defaults to 7 for bounds and 10 for domain or approach limits.

grading-method.description: How the response is graded: exact compares canonical structure, component grades visible fields separately, and equivalent checks symbolic equivalence.

body-relative-weight.description: Weight of the body relative to each limit field, whose weight is 1, when using component grading.

weight.description: Global question-score weight assigned to this element.

correct-answer.description: Complete correct answer as a supported parseable expression, including Custom(body, limits) when operator-latex is supplied; cannot be combined with component correct-answer attributes.

correct-answer-start.description: Correct lower-bound expression for the start field when using bounds limits.

correct-answer-end.description: Correct upper-bound expression for the end field when using bounds limits.

correct-answer-domain.description: Correct domain expression for the domain field when using domain limits.

correct-answer-target.description: Correct target expression for the target field when using approach limits.

correct-answer-body.description: Correct body expression when component correct-answer-... attributes are used.
